modalities.evidence: Dataset contains structural and functional MRI data
structural and functional MRI data and associated stimulus timing files

output.population: 20 healthy female and male participants from the local Providence, RI community (age 20-30 years old; 24.3 ± 3.7 years, mean ± s.d.)
output.summary: Structural and functional MRI with stimulus timing files, collected while participants viewed constant-light-intensity epochs at four irradiance levels through diffusing goggles, investigating a light-intensity pathway linking retinal ganglion cells and prefrontal cortex.
